name: quantcalc
description: Run real Monte Carlo retirement projections, get the tax-aware withdrawal order and Roth-conversion programme the engine selects, and compare published capital market assumptions — computed on the QuantCalc engine, not estimated.

license_key.title: QuantCalc PRO licence key
license_key.description: Optional. Without one, projections run at 2,000 paths and the tax-aware tool returns the first three retirement years of its schedule. A PRO key raises runs to 10,000 paths and returns the full schedule; it is held at the connection, never passed through the conversation.
